head_commit.message:
Implement paginated queries for the local agent message board (#46978)

## What changed

Implement `AgentMessageBoard` for `LocalAgentMessageBoard`, adding SQLite queries to list channels and threads, search posts, and read thread replies.

- Support Unicode case-insensitive substring search and post filters for channel, author, and `after_message_id`.
- Sort threads by creation time or latest activity, with reply counts and previews of the root post and latest reply.
- Bound pages to 50 results and post previews to a shared 20,000-character response budget. Use offset cursors for pagination; concurrent posts may shift results between pages.
- Add indexes for board and thread timestamp queries.

## Testing

Add integration tests covering pagination, page and preview caps, Unicode search and truncation, thread activity ordering, filtered search, and rejection of non-root thread IDs and unknown callers.

head_commit.message:
Add SQLite storage for local agent message boards (#46966)

## What changed

Add `LocalAgentMessageBoard` with persistent channels, posts, and subscriptions scoped by `SessionId`. Support channel creation, posting and replies, subscription changes, and bounded reads using Unicode character offsets.

Serialize mutations across independent handles with immediate transactions. Deduplicate retries by caller and request ID, reject changed requests that reuse an ID, and return existing post metadata without repeating notifications. Deliver deduplicated notifications after commit; notification failures leave committed posts successful and readable.

## Testing

Add integration tests covering concurrent retries across independent handles, reopening persisted boards, subscription routing, board isolation, Unicode reads, invalid recipients, inactive recipients, and notification failures.

Add SQLite storage for local agent message boards (#46966)

## What changed

Add `LocalAgentMessageBoard` with persistent channels, posts, and subscriptions scoped by `SessionId`. Support channel creation, posting and replies, subscription changes, and bounded reads using Unicode character offsets.

Serialize mutations across independent handles with immediate transactions. Deduplicate retries by caller and request ID, reject changed requests that reuse an ID, and return existing post metadata without repeating notifications. Deliver deduplicated notifications after commit; notification failures leave committed posts successful and readable.

## Testing

Add integration tests covering concurrent retries across independent handles, reopening persisted boards, subscription routing, board isolation, Unicode reads, invalid recipients, inactive recipients, and notification failures.

Configuration load errors can echo configuration values, including credentials, into diagnostic reports.

## What changed

Replace raw error messages in `config.load` failures with typed metadata. Report the file, line, and column when a `ConfigLoadError` is available, including when wrapped in an I/O error. Otherwise, report only the I/O error kind or a generic configuration load failure.

## Testing

Add regression tests and snapshots for malformed user and project configuration, an unknown model provider, and invalid header configuration. Verify that both tested JSON reporting modes omit the test credentials while retaining the expected failure details.
